repos_data.description: The fastest PDF library for Python and Rust. Text extraction, image extraction, markdown conversion, PDF creation & editing. 0.8ms mean, 5× faster than industry leaders, 100% pass rate on 3,830 PDFs. MIT/Apache-2.0.
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementation that integrates with the Nutrient Document Web Service (DWS) Processor API, providing powerful PDF processing capabilities for AI assistants.
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementation exposes document processing capabilities through natural language, supporting both direct human interaction and AI agent tool calling.
